description: This file defines the ConverterCreator interface used in the ofbiz framework to create converters that transform objects from one type to another.

classes.name: ConverterCreator
classes.description: An interface for classes that implement creation of type converters between Java object classes.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a Converter capable of converting objects from sourceClass to targetClass. Returns null if the converter is not supported.
